newsitem.title: CHINA: China air-con market seen chaotic, oversupplied.
newsitem.headline: China air-con market seen chaotic, oversupplied.

text.p: China's air-conditioner industry has become chaotic with production capacity far exceeding output and supply greater than demand, Shanghai's Business News said on Wednesday.

A recent survey shows China's annual production capacity has hit 20.39 million air-conditioners while output stood at around eight million, the newspaper said. Annual demand now stands at around 7.2 million, it said.
With demand increasing in the past few years, too many regions and companies have built plants to produce air-conditioners and blind production has become a serious problem, the newspaper said.

This has given birth to a large number of unqualified small producers, the newspaper said. China currently has a total of 408 air-conditioner makers with only 10 of them able to produce more than 300,000 air-conditioners a year.
As a result, many poor-quality air-conditioners have been made and put on the market, the newspaper said.
